description: Change the RATES on a rate-routed (dimension-routed) agreement — a regime's flat rate, a tiered regime's own ladder, or the shared tier ladder. Rates are given in PERCENT (1.5 = 1.5%); thresholds in dollars. Call WITHOUT confirm first to DRY-RUN: with no edits it LISTS the current regimes (their keys + rates) so you know what to change; with edits it echoes the intended change. Call again with confirm:true to apply. On apply the new rate goes live for future transactions immediately, and — because it moves money on already-accrued periods — a gated Recalculate card is raised that the operator approves in the workspace (the past-period adjustment posts only on approval; nothing is backdated through you). Structure (routing dimension, regime keys, member values) is NOT editable here — only rates. Refuses if posted to the ERP (supersede instead). Needs the agreement_id. Requires a connected Aurgus account.

confirm.description: Omit/false to DRY-RUN (list current rates or echo the change); true to apply and raise the gated Recalculate card.

regimes.description: Per-regime rate edits, keyed by the regime's key (from the dry-run list). Give flat_rate_pct for a flat regime, or tiers for a tiered regime's own ladder.

flat_rate_pct.description: New flat rate in percent (0.5 = 0.50%). Flat regimes only.

tiers.description: This regime's own tier ladder (tiered regimes that don't use the shared grid).

shared_tier_grid.description: The shared tier ladder (used by tiered regimes that tier on the whole book). Thresholds in dollars, rate in percent.

name: edit_agreement_rates
